title: Gummi gameplay: ship lifetime, HP, score, medals and mission state
scope: Coherent Gummi gameplay core. No claim of complete gb/gm semantics. Editor, weapon/energy, enemy AI, route assets and saving formats remain open.

methods.native_source_changes: Only isolated GummiFeatures.inl and its harness after parent authorization; no IDB, game or UI changes.

fields.name: active_player
fields.meaning: Active player ship, independent of Sora

fields.name: module_descriptor
fields.meaning: Native vptr +0, scheduler +8, packed next +20, state +36

fields.name: mission_phase
fields.meaning: Writes only permitted in observed normal phase8

fields.name: player_descriptor
fields.meaning: Decode must equal base72A860 whose native vptr is5B52B0

fields.name: player_phase
fields.meaning: 0 init,1 inactive,2 active,3 completion,4 stopped/dead,5 rebirth

fields.name: flags
fields.meaning: 0x10 dead,0x40000 rebirth; other flags have independent owners

fields.name: score
fields.meaning: Upper digits ordinary points; ones digit saturated damage-event counter

fields.name: rank
fields.meaning: Observed limit6 or16 according to mission variant

claims.Finding: Gummi module event0 creates its scheduler, stores it at module+8 and RVAAD9478, and starts subsystem initialization. Event1 tears down objects/resources, destroys the scheduler, then clears the Gummi heap through1E2020.
claims.Strength: fresh complete decompilation; critical neighboring ABIs separately verified
claims.Limitations: The scheduler global is not explicitly nulled in this path; nonzero scheduler alone does not establish active module ownership. Static evidence only; this analysis did not execute the game.

claims.Limitations: Many registration helpers remain separate analysis targets. Decompiler's unused register arguments are not callable ABI evidence. Static evidence only; this analysis did not execute the game.

claims.Finding: Resource-loading fiber waits for asynchronous loads and finally writes mission phase3 at RVAAD9474, releasing the main mission fiber's loading wait.

claims.Finding: Central mission fiber owns phaseAD9474: initialization/loading0..3, intro4..7, normal gameplay8, death10/11, rebirth12/13, goal14/16 and results/exit18/19. It spawns the ship at phase3, resets score/medals, starts active ship phase2 after intro, and observes ship phases4/5 for death/rebirth.

claims.Limitations: Labels describe observed behavior in this fiber; unknown/unhandled numeric states are not inferred. Never force this field to skip resource or transition work. Static evidence only; this analysis did not execute the game.

claims.Finding: Constructs the embedded ship atP+0x488 and PLAYER_STATE atP+0x570; stores input atP+0x568 and tuning pointer atP+0x560. Encodes descriptor72A860 into DWORD[P], publishes AF0540=P, then populates loadout stats and the ship-state backlink.

implementation.independent_review_result: No substantial issue found; static ABI, integer limits and ownership gates independently checked.
implementation.notes: Mock callouts validate ABI arguments. Tests do not execute copied native function bodies. Shared packed-pointer decoding is represented by a synthetic-RVA fixture.

trainer_limits: Only living-ship heal/refill and positive multiples-of-ten score additions are mutating actions.
HP recovery does not revive dead or rebirthing ships. No autoheal or invulnerability hook is implemented.
Score additions may affect subsequent native mission ranks, rewards and saved records.
Maximum HP and medal values are read-only. Installed parts recompute derived PLAYER_STATE fields.
Energy semantics and an editor contract were not established; no feature is invented from RTTI names.
Callbacks are fixed RVAs with complete function byte comparisons before invocation; all actions execute on engine thread with fresh heartbeat and immediate context revalidation.
Sora sceneReady is not a Gummi gate. Native GAME_MODE state1 is required for writes; state2 allows readouts only.
